maxVersionNote: 0.1.0 reads the type and shape tokens (--ds-weight-*, --ds-btn-radius, --ds-card-radius, --ds-input-radius) and every colour role systems define in src/styles/tokens.css, global.css, blocks/*.css and pages/*.css (the roles the site has no place for are declared ds-not-used, the colours over photographs ds-keep); src/lib/ds-slot.ts and the layout load data/ds-slot.css as in Tracy Base.
applies: data/ds-slot.css read per request by src/lib/ds-slot.ts; the template reads every value as var(--ds-*, <its own value>)
readsRolesNote: src/styles/tokens.css and global.css read every standard role variable, or declare it unused with a reason (ds-not-used) or keep it (ds-keep); the type and shape tokens are read with the template's own value as the fallback
modesNote: the page is near-black in both states: `data-theme="dark"` mirrors the system or QA dark state (an inline script in Base.astro) and no switch is drawn

contrast.heading: body :is(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6)
contrast.text: body :is(p, li, a, span, small, label, td, th, dd, dt, blockquote, figcaption, button)
contrast.block-text: body div:not(:has(> :is(div, p, ul, ol, section, article, header, footer, nav, main, aside, figure, table, form, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6)))

readyNote: measured 19/11/2026 with flow.mjs --cms emdash on a site built from the 0.1.0 package (the dev site, About page): the 15 featured systems at 1440 and 390, 34 of 34 steps pass, roles match on every view, page follows, every text reads at least as well as on the template. With no system worn the site is pixel-identical (0 differences against the baseline). Measurement: contracts/0.1.0/design-system-measurement.json
measureNote: Carousels (the home slideshow) are stopped on their first slide before each measure
